evidence: ASK: instruction.md:1 asks to 'build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day' with a per-job pipeline board and per-application conversations, multi-user concurrency ('nobody's work gets trampled'). instruction.md:3 requires one-stage moves with ordinary controls, shared manual order, Interview capacity, refused-move put-back with the colleague named, all-or-none multi-card moves and undo; :5 live updates within 15 s preserving open card/note/cursor; :7 paged long conversations with scroll anchoring, per-person unread, seen marks, per-user per-browser drafts surviving sign-out; :9 candidate portal with privacy; :11 Board, Conversations, Activity and candidate views; :13-15 Node/Express/SQLite server at /app with seeding-once and persistence across restarts. hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 add role matrix (401/403/404), versioned cards with 409, bulk ordering, undo semantics, append-only activity, 30-message paging, unread/seen definitions. STARTING POINT: environment/Dockerfile:17-23 creates /app containing only .gitkeep (identical to template Dockerfile), so there is nothing to tweak; the whole product must be built. Golden is ~1,500 lines across solution/app/src/{index,db,bootstrap}.js and public/js/{app,board,threads}.js, consistent with substantial work. SMALLEST SUBMISSION ANALYSIS (skill's Verify step): a static page or mock fails the gates — render gate needs a wrong-password refusal then real Recruiter sign-in to a usable workspace ('A static picture or only a health response is insufficient', gates/render/judge.toml:23); constraints gate needs a job and candidate created through UI and read back in an independent browser context as the Observer ('A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate', gates/constraints/judge.toml:47). score.py:41-48 zeroes reward if any gate fails or functional <= floor 0.05 (scoring.toml floors.functional=0.05). Strongest plausible broken app: auth + persistent job/candidate CRUD + static seeded board with notes, no moves/conversations/live updates. It passes both gates; in Functional (total weight 58.5) it could at most earn hro_job_open 0.5, hro_add_candidate 0.5, hro_add_email_rules 1, hro_restart 1.5 = 3.5/58.5 ~ 0.06; hro_anonymous/hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff need a successful move/message/note control which it lacks, so they score 0. Polish: all five rows (live board, live thread, earlier-place, failed send, session resume) require missing features -> 0. Visual likert (5 rows) judged on board, conversations and activity; missing surfaces would lower it. Ceiling roughly 0.6*0.06 + 0.2*~0.6 ~ 0.16 of 1.0, versus a full build; a single CRUD screen cannot earn the reward and the shaped partial credit is proportionate to real partial work. Conforming alternative that could fail: any route/file layout, polling vs SSE vs sockets, and naming are explicitly the builder's choice (instruction.md:11,13; hireops_rules.md:3-5,123,175), so the 'real product' demand does not force a specific implementation. RISK: verdict on the ask is source-determinable and passes, but raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the stub-ceiling estimate above is analytic, not a measured weak-app run, and visual-likert normalization in the harness was not inspected. Required discrimination evidence remains missing, so risk=true; no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
